# Description of data variables:

Sequencing identifier associated with the sequencing samples. They look like sequencing run and barcode information Time (4h and 24h) Stimulation (Candita/ Aspergillus / Rhizopus / RPMI(control group)) Samples (8 samples that represent 8 biological replicates/ 8 different human donours) Gene expression data (The nymbers represent the number of sequencing reads assigned to each gene in each sample)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load the raw_data and inspect the dataset

```{r}
raw_data <- read_csv("../data/raw_data.csv")
```

```{r}
head(raw_data, n=10)
```

Tidy the dataset:

1\) Extract sample metadata

```{r}
metadata_raw <- raw_data |>
  rename(parameter = ...1) |>
  slice(1:3)  # extract first 3 row with all metadata
```

2\) Transform the metadata from wide format to long format

```{r}
metadata_long <- metadata_raw |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -parameter,
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "value"
  )
# reorder metadata_long
metadata_long <- metadata_long |>
  select(sample_id, parameter, value)
```

3\) Back to wide, to have one row per sample

```{r}
metadata <- metadata_long |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = parameter,
    values_from = value
  ) |>
  rename(donor = sample) |>
  rename(stimulus = stimu)
```

4\) Renaming Stimulus column

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |> 
  mutate(
    stimulus = recode(stimulus,
      "RPMI"                  = "Control_group",
      "Candida-albicans"      = "C_albicans",
      "Aspergillus-fumigatus" = "A_fumigatus",
      "Rhizopus-oryzae"       = "R_oryzae"),
    time = factor(time, levels = c("4h", "24h"))
  )

head(metadata)
```

Save the metadata

```{r}
write_csv(metadata, "../data/metadata.csv")

```

5\) Get just the mrna counts

```{r}
counts <- raw_data |>
  rename(gene_id = ...1) |>
  filter(str_starts(gene_id, "ENSG"))
```

Save the counts

```{r}
write_csv(counts, "../data/counts.csv")
```

6\) Quality check

```{r}
#Any missing value?
metadata |>
  summarise(
    missing_sample_id = sum(is.na(sample_id)),
    missing_time = sum(is.na(time)),
    missing_stimu = sum(is.na(stimulus)),
    missing_donor = sum(is.na(donor))
  )
```

```{r}
# Check duplicated gene identifiers
counts |>
  summarise(
    duplicated_genes = sum(duplicated(gene_id))
  )
```

```{r}
# Check the experimental design
metadata |>
  count(time, stimulus)
```

```{r}
# Check donor distribution
metadata |>
  count(donor)
```

6\) More about quality control

```{r}
# Check duplicated gene IDs
counts |>
  count(gene_id) |>
  filter(n > 1)
```

```{r}
# Check missing values in count columns
counts |>
  summarise(across(-gene_id, ~ sum(is.na(.x))))
```

```{r}
# Identify genes with zero counts
# Calculate total counts per gene
counts <- counts |>
  mutate(across(-gene_id, as.integer))
counts <- counts |>
  mutate(total_counts = rowSums(across(-gene_id)))
```

```{r}
# filter the samples with 0 counts:
 # these genes that have no reads assigned to them in any sample
counts |>
  filter(total_counts == 0)

```

```{r}
# how many genes? 
counts |>
  summarise(
    total_genes = n(),
    zero_count_genes = sum(total_counts == 0)
  )
```
